rules.requirement: Each night*, you may choose a player: they die. If your last choice was no-one, choose 3 players tonight.

assertingTests.name: the Po may hit three players only after a night with no choice (BMR-PO-01)
a multi-target night step rejects the same player twice (BMR-INNKEEPER-01, BMR-SHABALOTH-01, BMR-PO-01)
the Po's choice of no one is recorded, also when it is poisoned, and a Po kept asleep keeps its last choice (BMR-PO-01, BMR-EXORCIST-01)
the Po's choice of a player is recorded with its death, and a Po who chooses the Goon is drunk (BMR-PO-01, BMR-GOON-01)
an impaired Po's choice is recorded the same way: the next night still takes three players (BMR-PO-01)
the Po's no-one is a recorded decision and a skip is refused (BMR-PO-01)
